title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Series arrives in the Philippines with innovative back display and Leica Dual-200MP Cameras
summary: Xiaomi Philippines officially unveiled its Xiaomi 18 Pro Series, featuring the 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Headlining the new flagship lineup is an innovative Back Display that reimagines how users…

blocks.text: Xiaomi Philippines officially unveiled its Xiaomi 18 Pro Series, featuring the 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Headlining the new flagship lineup is an innovative Back Display that reimagines how users interact with their smartphones. Equipped with a Leica Dual-200MP Camera System, the latest Snapdragon® 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 6 Mobile Platforms,and advanced AI capabilities, the series delivers a new standard in mobile imaging, performance, and personalization.
AI-enhanced Xiaomi Back Display unlocks new possibilities in imaging, productivity, and creativity

The Xiaomi 18 Pro Series builds on Xiaomi’s exploration of new form factors with a new Back Display. By unlocking the potential of the phone’s back cover, the innovative display brings users new camera experiences, improved productivity, and more ways to create, while acting as a gateway to intelligent life.

The Back Display is built with the same custom M11 panel as the main display, delivering up to 4,000 nits multi-scenario peak brightness and a 1-120Hz LTPO refresh rate³ for a consistent viewing experience from front to back. The Unified Underglass design places both the display and camera beneath a single sheet of glass, creating a clean, seamless finish with enhanced drop resistance of Corning® Gorilla® Glass Victus® 2.

Using the Back Display as a rear viewfinder brings flagship image quality to selfies, group photos, and vlogs. For group selfies, the camera automatically switches to ultra-wide when more than three people are detected, while 8K video capture at up to 30fps with real-time preview makes it easier than ever to record vivid, high-quality vlog content from the rear cameras.

The convenience of the Back Display extends to even more everyday moments, with notifications for calls, maps, ride-hailing, food delivery, and more information updates available at a glance. Pin to Back Display lets users pin text and images for quick reference, such as boarding passes and QR codes. With the option to customize from various dynamic wallpapers, the Back Display also offers plenty of room for personal expression.

Through AI, the Back Display unleashes more possibilities in interaction, personalization, and convenience. AI Interpreter turns the dual screens into a real-time translation tool that displays each speaker’s language on their respective side for face-to-face communication in 29 languages. The new GenAI Apps feature⁴ brings vibe coding to smartphones, enabling users to create mini apps by simply describing their ideas in natural language.⁵ More than 50 preset apps, from practical tools to mini-games, are available as starting points and offer customizable Back Display functionality to suit different needs. For more personalization, AI Group Photo Wallpapers⁶ lets users create fun composite portraits with pets, celebrities, or fictional characters, and set them directly as Back Display wallpapers.⁵
Leica optics and enhanced software bring the complete travel camera phone

Xiaomi 18 Pro Series advances mobile photography through a powerful combination of hardware innovation and software intelligence. An upgraded optical system co-engineered with Leica lays a strong foundation for every shot. At the same time, Xiaomi is exploring how AI can open up more ways to create.

Marking five years of partnership between Xiaomi and Leica, Xiaomi 18 Pro Series continues to bring together Xiaomi’s cutting-edge technology and Leica’s premium optics to unleash a new era of Leica mobile imagery. At the core is a new Leica Dual-200MP Camera System that leverages the latest breakthroughs in optical miniaturization to seamlessly integrate one of Xiaomi’s most advanced camera systems into the Back Display.

On the main camera, a Leica UltraPure Optical Design and f/1.67 Leica Summilux optical lens deliver sharp, crystal-clear images with true-to-life colors. For the telephoto, the new Power Prism periscope module combines light redirection and focusing into a single optical component, capturing 177% more light than other Pro Max models on the market.⁷

With Dual 200MP sensors—including a 1/1.28-inch main sensor and a 1/1.56-inch periscope telephoto sensor—both cameras deliver consistently sharp results with crisp detail preserved even after cropping. On the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, the main camera goes even further with the Light Fusion 960L, delivering a 16.2EV high dynamic range for backlit images. The 200MP periscope telephoto covers an extraordinary range, from classic 75mm portraits to 150mm optical-level zoom, all with striking clarity in daylight or at night. For subjects up close, its 12cm telemacro capability reveals fine textures and intricate details with impressive clarity.

Alongside these hardware upgrades, Xiaomi 18 Pro Series introduces Xiaomi’s latest progress in mobile imaging for the AI era, empowering professional photographers with even more ways for creative expression. Essential Moment brings three classic styles to Xiaomi 18 Pro Series, powered by Xiaomi on-device AI Imaging Model: B&W Film captures the depth and tonal range of classic monochrome photography, Iconic CCD recreates the vivid, saturated colors of CCD-era digital cameras, and Modern Vintage offers refined tones with natural detail for a timeless look. Users can also replicate the optical characteristics of two classic lenses—a 35mm Documentary lens and a 75mm Portrait lens with soft bokeh.

Additional creative capabilities are on hand through Xiaomi Creativity Assistant.⁸ During shooting, AI Portrait Fill Light intelligently brightens underexposed faces in backlit scenes for more natural portraits, while Xiaomi ProCut suggests better framing and composition in real time. After capture, AI Composition automatically analyzes the photo and recommends smarter crops for stronger compositions. With a growing suite of AI tools, every step from capture to final edit is covered for standout pieces.

For video creators, Xiaomi 18 Pro Series supports up to 4K at 120fps in Dolby Vision, along with 10-bit Log and 8K at 30fps. With the Back Display making rear-camera selfies and vlogging effortless, Xiaomi 18 Pro Series is an ideal travel camera phone for capturing every moment in stunning photo and video.
Global device debut of Snapdragon flagship platforms puts more power in your hands⁹

Xiaomi 18 Pro Series is the first to run on the new dual Snapdragon 8 Elite Mobile Platforms.¹ Xiaomi 18 Pro Max is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 Mobile Platform—Qualcomm Technologies’ most powerful mobile platform to date—while Xiaomi 18 Pro features the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Mobile Platform.¹

Both new SoCs are built on an advanced 2nm TSMC process node with Gate-All-Around (GAA) transistor architecture, delivering lower power draw and reducing heat generation under heavy workloads. The SoCs are powered by the Qualcomm Oryon™ CPU featuring two prime cores and six performance cores—including the world’s first mobile prime cores to clock up to 5GHz. On the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 compared to the previous generation, CPU performance increases by up to 13%,¹⁰ the rearchitected Qualcomm® Adreno™ GPU delivers up to 44% more performance,¹¹ and its Qualcomm® Hexagon™ NPU is 35% faster.¹² Improved AI computation capability on both devices meanwhile enables more on-device AI for tasks like offline translation and writing tools.¹³

Xiaomi 18 Pro Max introduces Offset Packaging technology that runs a direct copper thermal path from the SoC to the vapor chamber. This is also supported by Xiaomi’s next-generation 3D IceLoop cooling system, delivering up to 50% higher cooling efficiency for sustained peak performance under heavy workloads.¹⁴ Optimizations to both processing and thermal performance put Xiaomi 18 Pro Max at the top of its class with an AnTuTu benchmark score of 5,031,155.¹⁵

Keeping this high-power performance running for longer is a Xiaomi Silicon-carbon Battery featuring 28% silicon content.⁷ The design uses internal space more efficiently to increase battery capacity in a compact form factor. Xiaomi 18 Pro Max houses a massive 7,050mAh (typ) battery with 100W wired and 50W wireless HyperCharge; Xiaomi 18 Pro features a 6,000mAh (typ) battery with 90W wired and 50W wireless HyperCharge.¹⁶
A flagship display that takes on-screen privacy to the next level

Xiaomi 18 Pro Series introduces major display improvements that deliver industry-leading clarity, brightness, and color accuracy. Making its debut on the series, Xiaomi HyperRGB 2.0 uses an independent pixel structure in which each pixel contains a complete set of red, green, and blue sub-pixels for enhanced clarity and power efficiency. Reaching up to 4,000 nits of multi-scenario peak brightness, the screen stays clear even under direct sunlight, while a wide BT.2020 color gamut ensures rich, accurate color. For all-day viewing comfort, the display carries TÜV Rheinland Triple Eye Care Certification. An integrated ultrasonic fingerprint sensor meanwhile provides fast, secure unlocking, even with wet hands.

Beyond peak screen performance, the new Xiaomi Privacy Display with Privacy Mode is designed to keep users and their sensitive information safer in public spaces. Built directly into the display hardware, the technology allows standard screen pixels to be switched off, while dedicated privacy pixels with a narrower viewing angle stay lit, limiting visibility from the sides. Thanks to HyperRGB 2.0’s independent full-RGB subpixel architecture, privacy pixels operate without pixel sharing, keeping the screen sharp, vibrant, and crystal clear during normal use while shielding content from nearby onlookers when Privacy Mode is enabled. This reliable Privacy Display is further backed by TÜV Rheinland Effective Screen Privacy Protection.

Privacy protection also gets smarter with AI. Privacy Mode can be applied to selected apps, notifications, floating windows, and split-screen views, while Privacy Notice senses nearby onlookers and alerts the user through discreet vibrations or Xiaomi HyperIsland.¹⁷ For added convenience, users can activate Privacy Mode instantly with the customizable AI Button on the side of the phone. With flagship visuals and intelligent protection working seamlessly together, Xiaomi 18 Pro Series takes privacy further without compromising visual performance.
Slim and striking premium design

Xiaomi 18 Pro Series comes in two sizes: Xiaomi 18 Pro features a compact 6.4-inch display and 72mm body width, allowing comfortable one-handed use; Xiaomi 18 Pro Max expands to 6.9 inches, offering more screen space for video, gaming, and multitasking.¹⁸
The front display is framed by 0.99mm symmetrical bezels on all four sides,⁷ achieved through LIPO packaging technology to maximize the viewing area without adding body width.
The series is available in four colors: Black, White, Cosmic Blue, and the signature Velvet Red.¹⁹ Velvet Red pairs a deep, rich tone with a warmer texture for a premium look and feel.
A smarter experience, compatible across ecosystems

Xiaomi 18 Pro Series is powered by the latest Xiaomi HyperOS 4, redefining everyday usability through three core pillars—Effortless Performance, Effortless Aesthetics, and Effortless Interaction. Effortless Performance ensures ultimate fluidity, driven by an optimized Xiaomi HyperCore with Precision Workload Scheduling and Memory Preloading, alongside a reengineered Xiaomi HyperOS application runtime environment. Effortless Aesthetics features an all‑new soft light glass texture, interactive light effects, and adaptive spatial depth, bringing a warm, vibrant look to the system and more flexible personalization through lock screen styling and notification stacking.

Delivering even more Effortless Interaction, Xiaomi 18 Pro Series unifies user devices, creating seamless workflows and file sharing across Xiaomi devices and other ecosystems.²⁰ With the all-new Xiaomi Smart Hub, users can pin frequently used personal devices and home appliances to Control Center for quick access. Everyday tasks are also made seamless with AI: system-integrated AI assistant, Google Gemini²¹ helps users complete tasks across multiple apps using natural language prompts, while Circle to Search with Google²² lets users search and translate on-screen content with ease. Alongside Gemini, Xiaomi HyperAI makes capturing and organizing information easier, with AI Voice Note turning spoken ideas into notes, and AI Speech Recognition providing timestamped outlines and meeting summaries for easier review.²³

Xiaomi 18 Pro Max goes further in sound and touch. Its CyberEngine super-wideband X-axis linear motor delivers powerful and precise haptic feedback, making everything from typing to gaming feel more responsive and real. A symmetrical triple-speaker system brings richer, more spatial audio, while Xiaomi Privacy Call emits anti-phase sound waves through the rear speaker to make phone conversations less audible to people nearby.²⁴
More to enjoy with fun accessories

Xiaomi 18 Pro Series extends the experience with a range of dedicated accessories. Two custom magnetic cases let wireless chargers, power banks, car mounts, and stands snap on instantly. Designed to work with these cases, Xiaomi Magnetic Remote Stand tilts up to 90° and includes a detachable wireless remote to control the camera, video scrolling, e-books, and music. Combined with the Back Display and the versatile cameras, it makes hands-free photos and videos effortless.

As of 2026, Xiaomi has remained among the world’s top three smartphone brands for 6 consecutive years and ranked on the Fortune Global 500 for the 8th straight year. The launch of Xiaomi 18 Pro Series marks another breakthrough in Xiaomi’s premiumization strategy and a key step in its “Human × Car × Home” smart ecosystem. To continue deepening this long-term strategic vision, Xiaomi expects its global R&D investment to exceed EUR 24 billion from 2026 to 2030, driving innovation in cutting-edge technologies including AI, operating systems, in-house semiconductor capabilities, smart vehicles, robotics and smart manufacturing. Moving forward, Xiaomi will continue to strengthen its presence in the premium segment worldwide, bringing even more intelligent experiences to users around the world.
Availability & Pre-order Offers

The Xiaomi 18 Pro Series is available for pre-order in the Philippines from November 27 to December 17, 2026, in four colors: Velvet Red, Black, White and Cosmic Blue. The Xiaomi 18 Pro (12GB+512GB) is priced at ₱95,999, while the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max (12GB+512GB) retails for ₱105,999.

Customers who place a ₱1,000 deposit during the pre-order window will receive a ₱4,000 discount, a complimentary Xiaomi Watch S5 46mm (valued at ₱10,999), and an after-sales VIP Card offering up to ₱30,000 in benefits. Buyers can also get up to ₱12,000 in additional trade-in savings at participating retail stores.
Full pre-order mechanics and store locations are available through authorized Xiaomi stores and the brand’s official online channels, including the Mi Store, Shopee, and Lazada.
Xiaomi Expands Its Wearables Lineup with More Ways to Stay Connected

Alongside the Xiaomi 18 Pro Series, Xiaomi Philippines is also introducing three new wearables: the Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm, Xiaomi Smart Band 11, and Xiaomi Clip. Designed to complement different lifestyles, the lineup brings together fitness tracking, everyday convenience, and wireless audio in stylish, easy-to-wear designs.

The Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm combines the elegance of a traditional wristwatch with smart features for everyday use. Its compact stainless steel design houses a 1.32-inch AMOLED display with up to 3,000 nits of peak brightness, while its 590mAh battery delivers up to 14 days of use. Powered by Xiaomi HyperOS 4, the watch offers more than 150 sports modes, enhanced health and sleep tracking, and personalized workout suggestions, helping users stay on top of their daily routines.

For those looking for a lightweight fitness companion, the Xiaomi Smart Band 11 features a 1.72-inch AMOLED display with up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness and up to 21 days of battery life on the standard version. It supports more than 150 sports modes, upgraded heart rate monitoring, and improved sleep tracking. With a variety of colors and interchangeable straps, the band also offers more ways to match personal style.

Completing the lineup is the Xiaomi Clip, Xiaomi’s first clip-on open-ear earbuds. Weighing just 5.5g per earbud, its comfortable design allows users to enjoy music while remaining aware of their surroundings. Equipped with 11mm dynamic drivers, AI-powered call noise reduction, and up to 38 hours of playback with the charging case, Xiaomi Clip offers a practical audio companion for commuting, working, and everyday activities.
